agg_11.sql: SELECT SUM(n_videos) AS video_days FROM daily_trending WHERE country = 'Mexico' AND trending_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND trending_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

agg_12.sql: SELECT MEDIAN(likes::DOUBLE / views) AS like_rate, COUNT(*) AS n FROM videos WHERE category = 'Sports' AND likes IS NOT NULL AND views > 0

agg_13.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT trending_date) AS n_days FROM daily_trending WHERE country = 'Brazil'

agg_14.sql: SELECT AVG(comments) AS avg_comments, COUNT(*) AS n FROM videos WHERE category = 'Comedy' AND comments IS NOT NULL

agg_15.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT video_id) AS n_videos FROM video_country WHERE country = 'Brazil' AND first_date BETWEEN DATE '2023-01-01' AND DATE '2023-12-31'

fg_01.sql: SELECT v.category, COUNT(DISTINCT vc.video_id) AS n_videos FROM video_country vc JOIN videos v USING (video_id) WHERE vc.country = 'Brazil' GROUP BY v.category ORDER BY n_videos DESC LIMIT 10

fg_02.sql: SELECT v.channel_title, COUNT(DISTINCT vc.video_id) AS n_videos FROM video_country vc JOIN videos v USING (video_id) WHERE vc.country = 'South Korea' GROUP BY v.channel_title ORDER BY n_videos DESC, v.channel_title LIMIT 10

fg_03.sql: SELECT CASE pub_dow WHEN 0 THEN 'segunda' WHEN 1 THEN 'terça' WHEN 2 THEN 'quarta' WHEN 3 THEN 'quinta' WHEN 4 THEN 'sexta' WHEN 5 THEN 'sábado' ELSE 'domingo' END AS dia, MEDIAN(views) AS median_views, COUNT(*) AS n FROM videos GROUP BY pub_dow ORDER BY median_views DESC

fg_04.sql: SELECT category, 100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN is_short THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pct_shorts, COUNT(*) AS n FROM videos GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY pct_shorts DESC

fg_05.sql: SELECT MEDIAN(duration_s) AS median_seconds, COUNT(*) AS n FROM videos WHERE category = 'Music' AND views > 1000000

fg_06.sql: SELECT v.pub_hour, COUNT(*) AS n_videos FROM video_country vc JOIN videos v USING (video_id) WHERE vc.country = 'India' GROUP BY v.pub_hour ORDER BY n_videos DESC LIMIT 5

fg_07.sql: SELECT country, AVG(days_trending) AS avg_days, COUNT(*) AS n_videos FROM video_country GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5000 ORDER BY avg_days DESC LIMIT 10

fg_08.sql: SELECT MEDIAN(hours_to_trend) AS median_hours, COUNT(*) AS n FROM videos WHERE channel_subs > 10000000 AND hours_to_trend IS NOT NULL

fg_09.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT vc.video_id) AS n_videos FROM video_country vc JOIN videos v USING (video_id) WHERE vc.country = 'Portugal' AND v.category = 'Education' AND vc.first_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'

fg_10.sql: SELECT title, channel_title, n_trending_countries FROM videos WHERE category = 'Pets & Animals' AND n_trending_countries > 80 ORDER BY n_trending_countries DESC

fg_11.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_videos, MEDIAN(v.views) AS median_views FROM video_country vc JOIN videos v USING (video_id) WHERE vc.country = 'Iceland' AND v.category = 'Gaming' AND vc.first_date <= DATE '2024-01-31' AND vc.last_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'

cmp_01.sql: SELECT MEDIAN(v.views) FILTER (WHERE v.is_short) AS median_short, MEDIAN(v.views) FILTER (WHERE NOT v.is_short) AS median_long, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.is_short) AS n_short, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT v.is_short) AS n_long FROM video_country vc JOIN videos v USING (video_id) WHERE vc.country = 'Brazil'

cmp_02.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT video_id) FILTER (WHERE country = 'Brazil') AS n_brazil, COUNT(DISTINCT video_id) FILTER (WHERE country = 'Mexico') AS n_mexico FROM video_country WHERE first_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

cmp_03.sql: SELECT MEDIAN(n_videos) FILTER (WHERE trending_date < DATE '2025-07-01') AS median_h1, MEDIAN(n_videos) FILTER (WHERE trending_date >= DATE '2025-07-01') AS median_h2, CASE WHEN MEDIAN(n_videos) FILTER (WHERE trending_date >= DATE '2025-07-01') > MEDIAN(n_videos) FILTER (WHERE trending_date < DATE '2025-07-01') THEN 'up' ELSE 'down' END AS direction FROM daily_trending WHERE country = 'Brazil' AND category = 'Gaming' AND trending_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

cmp_04.sql: SELECT MEDIAN(v.views) FILTER (WHERE v.category = 'Music') AS median_music, MEDIAN(v.views) FILTER (WHERE v.category = 'Entertainment') AS median_entertainment FROM video_country vc JOIN videos v USING (video_id) WHERE vc.country = 'United States'

cmp_05.sql: SELECT MEDIAN(views) FILTER (WHERE pub_dow IN (5, 6)) AS median_weekend, MEDIAN(views) FILTER (WHERE pub_dow < 5) AS median_weekday, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pub_dow IN (5, 6)) AS n_weekend FROM videos

cmp_06.sql: SELECT AVG(days_trending) FILTER (WHERE country = 'Japan') AS avg_japan, AVG(days_trending) FILTER (WHERE country = 'South Korea') AS avg_korea FROM video_country

cmp_07.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE first_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31') AS n_dec2024, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE first_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31') AS n_dec2025, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE first_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE first_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31') THEN 'up' ELSE 'down' END AS direction FROM video_country WHERE country = 'Brazil'

cmp_08.sql: SELECT AVG(n_trending_countries) FILTER (WHERE duration_s <= 600) AS avg_countries_short, AVG(n_trending_countries) FILTER (WHERE duration_s > 1200) AS avg_countries_long FROM videos
